decisions.label: Sigil runs
decisions.note: Hold the sigil button (E, the pad's square, touch) on after a press that picked a sigil up and she keeps picking up every sigil she runs over; hold it after a press that put one down and each empty hex she walks into takes the next (Ed, 2026-10-15). Off: a press does one thing, holding does nothing more (holding E with nothing to do still puts her hat down either way).
